cohort: 31 puerperium patients with VTE (cases) and 279 puerperium women without VTE (controls) matched for age, number of fetuses, birth day, and delivery mode
finding: The combination of the Caprini RAM and D-dimer levels significantly elevated the predictive value for VTE during puerperium.
mod_finding: This study on venous thromboembolism (VTE) during puerperium included delivery mode as a matching factor but did not report specific findings related to mode of delivery.
